notes.title: Clive 'N' Wrench Update! Patch v1.1.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35135724/1deddbbda47ba52edb78f278b756e33b552e0d73.png[/img]

Hi everyone,
A big thanks to all of you that have played Clive 'N' Wrench thus far! It's been a blast seeing so many of you discovering the game for the first time.

[b]Changes include:[/b]
- Fixed a bug that could cause Clive to get stuck in a ledge grab.
- Re-enabled the erroneously disabled lighting in 'Cajun Mob Bog'.
- Increased the speed of the camera's analog stick movement (with hope to add sliders in the future).
- Removed some collision in 2D sections of 'Bluebeard's Gauntlet', that players could bump their heads on.
- Fixed prop pop-in that could occur in The Chimp The Bag & The Bunny.
- Fixed flickering lights when too many were on screen at once in some areas.
- Added penguins holding "duck" signs to Droo the Ripper's boss fight to remind players of the move, and establish they can duck his scissor throws.
- Added the ability to return to the main menu from the hub.
- Fixed misaligned images in the credits.
- Enabled v-sync, as uncapped frames were causing issues on higher end hardware (with hope to add a toggle in the future).

[b]We will be continuing to address feedback with ongoing patches.[/b]

notes.title: New Trailer & More! Game Releases February 2023
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's a bit surreal but after many years of development, Clive 'N' Wrench is finally coming and it lands on Steam in February 2023! We want to thank all of you who have kept talking about the game over the years at every opportunity, and more importantly want to say thanks for not giving up hope on this game. It's a real love letter to 3D Platformers top to bottom, and we can't wait for you experience it.

We announced the game was finally coming in a new [url=https://youtu.be/DDPKVSXCsGU]Gameplay Trailer[/url] back in October and shortly followed this up with a [url=https://youtu.be/2GB1UrK57g8]Halloween World Showcase[/url]. Given we just hit the end of the first week of December, we wanted to preview one of Clive 'N' Wrench's winter themed game worlds... Iceratops!

[h1]Love Christmas? Love Dinosaurs? You're in for a treat![/h1]

No 3D Platformer is complete without an ice world and Clive 'N' Wrench takes that to eclectic levels with Iceratops, the games very own prehistoric winter wonderland. Mixing together Christmas cheer and the demise of the Dinosaurs, Clive 'N' Wrench are in for a challenge if they want to collect all the pocket watches and Ancient Stones the world has to offer. Make sure you check out the brand-new trailer that showcases the world in all its 3D Collecting glory, after all, 'tis the season!

🌍 Explore a prehistoric platforming playground.
🐱‍🐉 Ascend to new heights, using dinosaurs to reach platforms above.
🐤 Fight your way through imps, dino skeletons and is that... the Dodo?
🧊 Time your jumps carefully as you navigate ice filled primordial goo.
🎅 Meet Father Noelephant and help reunite him with his missing presents!
⌚ Collect Ancient Stones & Pocket Watches to proceed to the next world.

[previewyoutube=Z4FGtGxNiRw;full][previewyoutube=Z4FGtGxNiRw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

Wishing you all a great Holiday Season, we'll have a number of updates on Clive 'N' Wrench before the game launches in February :). See you in the new year!

Stay tuned to our socials for more updates.
